notes.title: Dev Note #2: Visual Update - Portrait Unveiled – Meet Frank
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve just added the first of the new portraits to the game, one of several character reveals planned over the coming weeks. 

This one is for [b]Frank[/b], the groundskeeper at Breken House.
[/p][p]You’ll meet Frank early on, at a quiet rural station in the middle of nowhere. He’s waiting there when you arrive. Don't expect a warm welcome. Just a nod and a heavy silence that sets the tone for your journey through the snowy Devonshire roads to Breken House.[/p][p]
This new portrait aims to capture who Frank is beneath the surface, distant, quiet, and weighed down by a history he won’t speak of. 

He’s been part of the estate longer than anyone else, and his presence will set the tone for the night to come.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674805/ac9390ea09f92e47d466972989bd9b72b5632dd1.png"][/img][/p][p]We’ll be sharing more snippets of the world like this soon, little pieces, one at a time, as we get closer to the new trailer and start unveiling the bigger picture.
[/p][p]Thanks again for following along so early. It makes a real difference. And if you haven’t yet, please consider hitting that ⭐ Wishlist button, it helps the game more than you might think.
[/p][p]More soon,
— Mowlo [/p]

notes.title: Dev Note #1: Visual Update and What’s Next
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]We’ve just updated our Steam page with new capsule art that better captures the heart of Hollow Mire — its atmosphere, tone, and emotional focus. If you’ve seen the page before, this new look is a big step toward how we want the game to feel when you first encounter it.[/p][p]This is the first of several updates we’re making as we gear up for the new look trailer, which is still in the works. We didn’t want to wait to share this progress with you — and we’re grateful for everyone who’s already wishlisted or recommended the game along.[/p][quote][p]💬 What’s next:[/p][list][*][p]Trailer coming soon[/p][/*][*][p]More behind-the-scenes looks[/p][/*][*][p]Deeper story reveals and world-building content[/p][/*][/list][/quote][p]Thanks for being here early — it means a lot. If you haven’t already, hit the ⭐ [i]Wishlist[/i] button to stay in the loop and support the project.[/p][p]More soon,
— Mowlo Game Studio[/p]
